taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-03 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-03
Curve type: A-type (ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4)
Aquifer depth: 13.27 – 25.48 m (weathered/fractured zone, layers 2–3)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the 13.3–25.5 m interval, which corresponds to the moderately resistive weathered/fractured horizon likely to hold groundwater; terminate drilling near 25–26 m once the highly resistive (>2500 ohm-m) fresh basement is encountered, as it is unlikely to yield water.
